articles.title: Alvarez’s Extra-Time Thunderbolt Sends Argentina Past Switzerland, Sets Up Semifinal with England
articles.summary: Julian Alvarez unleashed a 25-yard rocket in the 112th minute to break a deadlock and push Argentina past 10-man Switzerland 3-1. The defending champions now face England in a high-stakes semifinal on Wednesday in Atlanta.

articles.title: Bellingham’s Late Strike in Sweltering Heat Sends England Past Norway to World Cup Semifinals
articles.summary: Jude Bellingham scored in the 93rd minute of extra time to give England a 2-1 victory over Norway in a quarterfinal played in dangerous 108-degree heat. England now meets Argentina in the semifinals on Wednesday in Atlanta.

articles.title: Guggenheim Museum Among Buildings Testing Positive for Legionella in NYC Outbreak
articles.summary: The iconic Guggenheim Museum was one of 31 Upper East Side buildings that tested positive for Legionella bacteria, prompting city-ordered disinfection. Over 50 cases have been diagnosed in the cluster, with no deaths reported so far.
